description: Defines the abstract class SymbolSupplier for providing symbol files and data for code modules, including methods for retrieving symbol files, symbol data, and managing memory buffers.

classes.name: SymbolSupplier
classes.description: Abstract base class for symbol providers, with methods to retrieve symbol files and data for code modules.

methods.name: GetSymbolFile
methods.description: Retrieves the symbol file path for a given code module, optionally using system info.

methods.name: GetSymbolFile
methods.description: Retrieves the symbol file path and symbol data for a given code module.

methods.name: GetCStringSymbolData
methods.description: Allocates and retrieves symbol data as a C-string buffer for a code module.

methods.name: FreeSymbolData
methods.description: Frees the memory buffer allocated for symbol data.
